rules.rationale: This nullary equation expands solutionModule to the exact translated program AST; it defines a named proof term and does not replace execution of the AST.

This guarded simplification rewrites built-in integer remainder rather than defining a named summary, so it is an additional arithmetic fact used by the target proof; the mandatory simplification-rule constraint places it in DOMAIN_LEMMA despite the separate bridge-free Stage 1 proof evidence.

This guarded simplification rewrites built-in integer division rather than defining a named summary, so it is an additional arithmetic fact used by the target proof; the mandatory simplification-rule constraint places it in DOMAIN_LEMMA despite the separate bridge-free Stage 1 proof evidence.
This is the base equation of the recursive decodeBin mathematical summary, defining the empty code sequence to have value zero.
This is the recursive equation defining decodeBin on a nonempty code sequence by positional base-two decoding of its head and strict tail.
This is the base equation defining the allBinDigits structural predicate on the empty sequence.
This is the recursive equation defining allBinDigits by checking the head code and recurring on the strict tail.
This equation defines the canonicalBin predicate's special canonical-zero case.
This equation defines canonical nonzero binary strings as sequences beginning with the code for one whose remaining codes satisfy allBinDigits.
This owise equation is the exhaustive fallback of the canonicalBin predicate and completes its structural definition.
This equation defines the digitDomain predicate that names the five-digit symbolic parameterization of the bounded input domain.
